description:
Answer a question about one of the user's uploaded files.

    Reads the file's contents and returns LuBot's answer: numbers computed
    from CSV / Excel tables, or text found in PDF, Word and image files, with
    the file named as the source. Use this when the user asks about one
    specific file; get the file_id from list_files first. Don't use it to
    compare several files at once.

    Limits: requires sign-in; counts toward the user's LuBot plan like a
    My Files question; one file per call; answers can take up to a minute;
    questions are capped at 2000 characters.
name: analyze_file
title: Analyze a File
